text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I went to the shopping 
district to run some errands. Just then...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Spe-chan! Time for some good 
luck, and—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: A food-coma feast trip, is it?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer, would you like to come along 
too? To the "Eat Till You Drop! Seven 
Lucky Gods Gourmet Tour"♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Blessed by the Seven Lucky Gods, not just 
stomach-full, but fortune-full. This event 
was practically made for me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And besides! I even prepared this good 
luck charm specially for today!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Its name is the "Never-Get-Full Charm"!! 
I'll give you two spares!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Now we can pile on extra rice with 
peace of mind, and pile on extra divine 
blessings too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: E-Even the weight...!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawa, Fukukitaru-san! Do you also 
happen to have a charm that keeps me from 
gaining extra weight!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No... The other day, a certain young lady 
from a prestigious family, Macq—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: No wayyyyyy!

"Next time, we'll make sure our charm 
preparations are flawless..." With that 
mutual vow, the two headed back home.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Then to start off, 10 orders of... 
'Ebisu's Shrimp Tendon'!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I'll go order 10 servings of 
"Daikokuten-sama's Radish Oden" too~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That was delicious! Maybe it's thanks to 
the charm, but I polished off 10 servings 
just like that~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Th-That's... true, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Next is "Benzaiten-sama's Zenzai"... 
Sweets go to a different stomach, so 
twenty servings should be easy♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah... On the other side of the river... 
Lady Shiraoki is... waving... her hand...

True to the word, this food-crawl journey 
continued until we literally dropped from 
eating...
